actions.name: getPageContent
actions.description: Get page content and optionally all its descendants

actions.name: get-page-by-url
actions.description: Fetches a page by its Confluence web URL (extracts the page ID automatically).

actions.name: find-page-by-title
actions.description: Finds a page by exact title, optionally scoped to a space.

actions.name: search-pages
actions.description: Search Confluence content with CQL (Confluence Query Language). Example: `type = "page" AND space = "DOCS" AND title ~ "release"`.

actions.name: create-page
actions.description: Creates a new page in a space with the given title and body.

actions.name: create-page-from-template
actions.description: Creates a new page from a template with the given title and variables.

actions.name: update-page
actions.description: Updates the title, body, or status of an existing page.

actions.name: delete-page
actions.description: Trashes or permanently deletes a page.

actions.name: move-page
actions.description: Moves a page to a new parent as a child, sibling, or to the top of the parent.

actions.name: publish-draft
actions.description: Publishes a draft page (changes status from draft to current).

actions.name: add-comment
actions.description: Adds a footer comment to a page.

actions.name: reply-to-comment
actions.description: Replies to an existing footer comment on a page.

actions.name: list-comments
actions.description: Lists footer and/or inline comments on a page.

actions.name: upload-attachment
actions.description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a page.

actions.name: download-attachment
actions.description: Downloads an attachment file by its ID and returns it as a file.

actions.name: list-attachments
actions.description: Lists all attachments on a page.

actions.name: add-label
actions.description: Adds one or more labels to a page.

actions.name: remove-label
actions.description: Removes a label from a page.

actions.name: find-user
actions.description: Looks up Confluence users by name, email, or keyword.

actions.name: list-spaces
actions.description: Lists all spaces the authenticated user can access.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new-page
triggers.description: Triggers when a new page is created.

triggers.name: updated-page
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing page is updated (version > 1).

triggers.name: new-comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new footer comment is added to the selected page.

triggers.name: new-attachment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new attachment is uploaded to the selected page.

triggers.name: new-blog-post
triggers.description: Triggers when a new blog post is published in the selected space.
